decisions: Reverse all 64 LED orientations relative to v3: column anodes, row cathodes.
Both IC outputs drive gate/address networks only; LED current follows external P/N stages.
1k series on all sixteen gates; 10k gate-source pulls; eight 10k cathode bias resistors.
PC5/6/7 address outputs open-drain with 4.7k pullups to common 3.3V.
LOW row-gate blanking and active-HIGH main PWM; complementary outputs disabled.
100us blank, 250Hz frames, 10kHz PWM and gamma retained; low-end optical PWM pending.
Stock ICs/LEDs/other seed passives retained; I2C head-only/contact/mechanical integration pending.
No board access, order, inventory mutation or main-project CAD promotion.
physical_validation: New MOSFET candidate not physically tested. HC138 3.3V loaded drive, MOSFET/address settling, current, temperature, low-end PWM, reset and chain behavior remain to check. Previously reported v3 PWM ghosting is resolved and user-confirmed.
